routing_semantics.mode_filter: Use only edges allowing requested mode and meeting full assembly envelope; manual cart cannot enter pedestrian terminal.
routing_semantics.unreachable_or_empty_graph: Return no_path with empty path; never substitute a straight line/zero-distance successful route.
routing_semantics.reservations_and_collision: Graph reachability does not schedule intersecting agents; later replay/backend reserves actual resources and accounts for waits.
routing_semantics.no_interiors: Only external zone gateways; storage/staging/reserve interiors and undefined slot addresses are not graph-connected.
